arxiv-1410-1271.title: The Role of Nucleobase Interactions in RNA Structure and Dynamics
arxiv-1410-1271.creator: Sandro Bottaro 1,∗ , Francesco di Palma 1 , Giovanni Bussi 1,
arxiv-1410-1271.description: Abstract The intricate network of interactions observed in RNA three-dimensional structures is often described in terms of a multitude of geometrical properties, including helical parameters, base pairing/stacking, hydrogen bonding and backbone conformation. We show that a simple molecular representation consisting in one oriented bead per nucleotide can account for the fundamental structural properties of RNA.

arxiv-2007-15211.title: NeuralQA: A Usable Library for Question Answering (Contextual Query Expansion + BERT) on Large Datasets
arxiv-2007-15211.creator: Victor Dibia
arxiv-2007-15211.description: Abstract Existing tools for Question Answering (QA) have challenges that limit their use in practice. They can be complex to set up or integrate with existing infrastructure, do not offer configurable interactive interfaces, and do not cover the full set of subtasks that frequently comprise the QA pipeline (query expansion, retrieval, reading, and explanation/sensemaking).

arxiv-2104-03320.title: Galaxy power spectrum and biasing results from the LOFAR Two-metre Sky Survey (first data release)
arxiv-2104-03320.creator: Prabhakar Tiwari, Ruiyang Zhao, Jinglan Zheng, Gong-Bo Zhao, David Bacon, Dominik J. Schwarz
arxiv-2104-03320.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Prabhakar Tiwari, Ruiyang Zhao, Jinglan Zheng, Gong-Bo Zhao, David Bacon, Dominik J. Schwarz. The LOFAR Two-metre Sky Survey (LoTSS) is an ongoing survey aiming to observe the entire Northern sky, providing an excellent opportunity to study the distribution and evolution of the large-scale structure of the Universe. The source catalogue from the public LoTSS first data release (DR1) covers 1% of the sky, and shows correlated noise or fluctuations of the flux density calibration on few degree scales.

arxiv-2104-04776.title: A crossover of the solid substances solubility in supercritical fluids: what is it in fact?
arxiv-2104-04776.creator: Kalikin N.N, Oparin R.D, Kolesnikov A.L, Budkov Y.A, Kiselev M.G
arxiv-2104-04776.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kalikin N.N, Oparin R.D, Kolesnikov A.L, Budkov Y.A, Kiselev M.G. We investigate a well-known phenomenon of the appearance of the crossover points, corresponding to the intersections of the solubility isotherms of the solid compound in supercritical fluid.

arxiv-2108-06345.title: Cooling-Induced Vortex Decay in Keplerian Disks
arxiv-2108-06345.creator: Jeffrey Fung, Tomohiro Ono
arxiv-2108-06345.description: Abstract Vortices are readily produced by hydrodynamical instabilities, such as the Rossby wave instability, in protoplanetary disks. However, large-scale asymmetries indicative of dust-trapping vortices are uncommon in sub-millimeter continuum observations. One possible explanation is that vortices have short lifetimes. In this paper, we explore how radiative cooling can lead to vortex decay.

arxiv-2109-10242.title: Multidimensional Transonic Shock Waves and Free Boundary Problems
arxiv-2109-10242.creator: Gui-Qiang G. Chen, Mikhail Feldman
arxiv-2109-10242.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gui-Qiang G. Chen, Mikhail Feldman. We are concerned with free boundary problems arising from the analysis of multidimensional transonic shock waves for the Euler equations in compressible fluid dynamics. In this expository paper, we survey some recent developments in the analysis of multidimensional transonic shock waves and corresponding free boundary problems for the compressible Euler equations and related nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) of mixed type.

arxiv-2202-13580.title: Femtosecond laser-shockwave induced densification in fused silica
arxiv-2202-13580.creator: A. Radhakrishnan, J. Gateau, P. Vlugter, Y. Bellouard
arxiv-2202-13580.description: Abstract Tightly focused femtosecond laser-beam in the non-ablative regime can induce a shock-wave enough to reach locally pressures in the giga-Pascal range or more. In a single beam configuration, the location of the highest-pressure zone is nested within the laser-focus zone, making it difficult to differentiate the effect of the shock-wave pressure from photo-induced and plasma relaxation effect.

arxiv-2308-15282.title: Diffusion-based kernel density estimation improves the assessment of carbon isotope modelling
arxiv-2308-15282.creator: Maria-Theresia Pelz, Christopher Somes
arxiv-2308-15282.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Maria-Theresia Pelz, Christopher Somes. Comparing differently sized data sets is one main task in model assessment and calibration. This is due to field data being generally sparse compared to simulated model results. We tackled this task by the application of a new diffusion-based kernel density estimator (diffKDE) that approximates probability density functions of a data set nearly independent of the amount of available data.

arxiv-2403-06813.title: LeOCLR: Leveraging Original Images for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
arxiv-2403-06813.creator: Mohammad Alkhalefi m.alkhalefi1.21@abdn.ac.uk, Georgios Leontidis georgios.leontidis@abdn.ac.uk, Mingjun Zhong mingjun.zhong@abdn.ac.uk
arxiv-2403-06813.description: Abstract Contrastive instance discrimination methods outperform supervised learning in downstream tasks such as image classification and object detection. However, these methods rely heavily on data augmentation during representation learning, which can lead to suboptimal results if not implemented carefully. A common augmentation technique in contrastive learning is random cropping followed by resizing.

arxiv-2404-12190.title: Estimating the Hessian Matrix of Ranking Objectives for Stochastic Learning to Rank with Gradient Boosted Trees
arxiv-2404-12190.creator: Jingwei Kang, Maarten de Rijke, Harrie Oosterhuis
arxiv-2404-12190.description: Abstract . Stochastic learning to rank (LTR) is a recent branch in the LTR field that concerns the optimization of probabilistic ranking models. Their probabilistic behavior enables certain ranking qualities that are impossible with deterministic models. For example, they can increase the diversity of displayed documents, increase fairness of exposure over documents, and better balance exploitation and exploration through randomization.

arxiv-2408-08009.title: Combined search in dwarf spheroidal galaxies for branon dark matter annihilation signatures with the MAGIC telescopes
arxiv-2408-08009.creator: D. Nieto
arxiv-2408-08009.description: Abstract Massive brane fluctuations, called branons, behave as weakly interacting massive particles, which is one of the most favored class of candidates to fulfill the role of the dark matter (DM), an elusive kind of matter beyond the Standard Model.

arxiv-2601-21542.title: Bi-Anchor Interpolation Solver for Accelerating Generative Modeling
arxiv-2601-21542.creator: Hongxu Chen, Hongxiang Li, Zhen Wang, Long Chen
arxiv-2601-21542.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hongxu Chen, Hongxiang Li, Zhen Wang, Long Chen. Flow Matching (FM) models have emerged as a leading paradigm for high-fidelity synthesis. However, their reliance on iterative Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) solving creates a significant latency bottleneck. Existing solutions face a dichotomy: training-free solvers suffer from significant performance degradation at low Neural Function Evaluations (NFEs), while training-based one- or few-steps generation methods incur prohibitive training costs and lack plug-and-play versatility. To bridge this gap, we propose the Bi-Anchor Interpolation Solver (BA-solver) .

europmc-pmc4009604.title: Neo-antigens predicted by tumor genome meta-analysis correlate with increased patient survival.
europmc-pmc4009604.creator: Brown SD, Warren RL, Gibb EA, Martin SD, Spinelli JJ, Nelson BH, Holt RA.
europmc-pmc4009604.description: Somatic missense mutations can initiate tumorogenesis and, conversely, anti-tumor cytotoxic T cell (CTL) responses. Tumor genome analysis has revealed extreme heterogeneity among tumor missense mutation profiles, but their relevance to tumor immunology and patient outcomes has...

pmc-11272779.title: Context-aware geometric deep learning for protein sequence design
pmc-11272779.creator: Lucien F Krapp, Fernando A Meireles, Luciano A Abriata, Jean Devillard, Sarah Vacle, Maria J Marcaida, Matteo Dal Peraro
pmc-11272779.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Protein design and engineering are evolving at an unprecedented pace leveraging the advances in deep learning. Current models nonetheless cannot natively consider non-protein entities within the design process. Here, we introduce a deep learning approach based solely on a geometric transformer of atomic coordinates and element names that predicts protein sequences from backbone scaffolds aware of the restraints imposed by diverse molecular environments. To validate the method, we show that it can produce highly thermostable, catalytically active enzymes with high success rates.

pmc-11608734.title: Metabolomics as a promising technology for investigating external therapy of traditional Chinese medicine: A review
pmc-11608734.creator: Xinyue Yang, Min He, Qingqing Tang, Jiazhen Cao, Zhe Wei, Tie Li, Mengmeng Sun
pmc-11608734.description: To demonstrate the potential for connecting metabolomics with traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) external therapies such as acupuncture and moxibustion, we conducted a literature review on metabolomics as a measurement tool for determining the efficacy of various TCM external therapies. Human research and animal models published in the last 10 years were summarized.

pmc-11656427.title: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic modeling to predict the effect of risperidone on aripiprazole pharmacokinetics in subjects with different CYP2D6 genotypes and individuals with hepatic impairment
pmc-11656427.creator: Fan Mou, Zhiwei Huang, Yu Cheng, Xue Zhao, Xiujia Sun, Huafang Li, Shunying Yu
pmc-11656427.description: Background:Aripiprazole and risperidone, widely used atypical antipsychotics, are commonly adjunctively prescribed in clinical practice. When aripiprazole was combined with risperidone, the genotype of drug-metabolizing enzymes and liver impairment may lead to complex pharmacokinetic changes. The Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic (PBPK) model can predict the influence of these factors on plasma concentration and optimize dosage regimens.

pmc-11717993.title: Sleep Quality of Morbidly Obese Patients After Bariatric Surgery
pmc-11717993.creator: Yoonhong Kim, Ae Ri Yang, Kwangwook Koh, Kyung Won Seo, Ki Hyun Kim
pmc-11717993.description: PurposeObesity is a major risk factor for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), associated with conditions like type 2 diabetes, hypertension, stroke, cancer, and premature death. OSA involves sleep-breathing interruptions, with over 60% of obese individuals diagnosed through polysomnography. This study explores sleep issues in individuals considering bariatric surgery.

pmc-12733039.title: Metabolomic Analysis of Goji Berry Sun-Drying: Dynamic Changes in Small-Molecule Substances
pmc-12733039.creator: Yao Zhang, Hui Ma, Wan-Ting Zou, Yan-Yan Zhu, Gui-Juan Ma, Yi Lv, Yong-Jie Yu, Paula C Castilho, Przemysław Kowalczewski
pmc-12733039.description: Goji berries (Lycium barbarum L.) are valued for their nutritional and medicinal properties; however, the systematic biochemical impact of drying on their quality remains poorly understood. This study applied an untargeted metabolomics approach based on UHPLC-HRMS and AntDAS to profile metabolic changes during sun-drying. Multivariate analyses (PCA and PLS-DA) revealed distinct time-dependent clustering, indicating significant shifts in the metabolome.

pmc-13115469.title: Comparison of Oleogels Obtained by Emulsion Template Method Using Low Molecular Weight Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose (HPMC) with Fish and Vegetable Oils
pmc-13115469.creator: Alonso Escobar, Leticia Montes, Amaya Franco-Uría, Ramón Moreira
pmc-13115469.description: This work evaluated the influence of oil type (sunflower vs. fish oil) and hydroxypropyl methylcellulose (HPMC) concentration on the properties of oleogels obtained by the emulsion-templated method. Oil-in-water emulsions were prepared and air-dried to produce oleogels containing 2.9–5.8% (w/w) HPMC. All oleogels exhibited solid-like behaviour, with viscoelastic moduli increasing with polymer concentration, and showed a high thermal stability.

pmc-13253088.title: Vitamin D as a cellular endocrine system: Tissue-specific microcircuits, immune reprogramming, and metabolic resistance
pmc-13253088.creator: Jialiang Feng, Jun Xiao, Zhiyuan Gao, Hui Zhou, Xilian Li, Yini Tian, Biao Gao
pmc-13253088.description: SummaryCirculating 25-hydroxyvitamin D is the standard marker of vitamin D status, but tissue responses to vitamin D vary across organs, inflammatory states, and clinical settings. This review frames vitamin D biology as a cellular endocrine system in which substrate transport, local CYP27B1-mediated activation, CYP24A1-mediated inactivation, and VDR responsiveness form tissue-specific microcircuits.

pmc-13447821.title: Dataset for selecting surrogates of emerging biothreat pathogens in laboratory research
pmc-13447821.creator: Anthony N Alfredo, Dawn Garrison, Jessica E Hall, Anna C Smith, Megan W Howard, Ryan R James, Katherine Ratliff, Vipin Rastogi, M Worth Calfee
pmc-13447821.description: Exposure to and transmission of biothreat agents is a serious concern with potentially devastating public health consequences. The rapid development of environmental countermeasure strategies is essential for mitigation efforts, as observed during the recent SARS-CoV-2 pandemic. Only a limited number of laboratories are equipped with the proper containment facilities to handle highly pathogenic biothreat agents.

pmc-13464291.title: Atrial Synchrony Restored With Bachmann Bundle Pacing
pmc-13464291.creator: Amarpal Karamjit Singh, Georgios Zisis, Kai Van Leeuwen, Vivek Mutha
pmc-13464291.description: Case SummaryCapturing intrinsic interatrial conduction with Bachmann bundle (BB) pacing is known as a more physiological atrial pacing strategy than conventional right atrial appendage pacing. We present a 74-year-old man with sinus node dysfunction and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation who underwent dual-chamber pacemaker implantation, incorporating BB and left bundle branch ventricular pacing.

pmc-13540773.title: Surgical strategy to minimize dominant hemisphere retraction in an asymmetric giant tuberculum sellae meningioma with contralateral anterior cerebral artery positioning: A case report
pmc-13540773.creator: Uygun Altibayev, Jakhongirmirzo Yoldoshev, Gayrat Kariev, Alvaro Campero
pmc-13540773.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Large asymmetric tuberculum sellae meningiomas are technically demanding anterior skull base lesions because of their close relationships with the optic apparatus and the anterior cerebral artery–anterior communicating artery complex (ACA-AComA). Although tumor lateralization is commonly considered during approach selection, it may be insufficient as an isolated determinant in cases with contralateral vascular displacement and marked peritumoral edema involving the dominant frontal lobe.

pmc-13548647.title: Predicting mortality risk in hospitalized ACS patients with hypertensive comorbidity: an interpretable machine learning approach
pmc-13548647.creator: Sazzli Kasim, Kiew Xue Ning, Sorayya Malek, Putri Nur Fatin Amir Rudin, Chien Wen Koh, Khairul Shafiq Ibrahim, Alan Yean Yip Fong, Wan Azman Wan Ahmad

pmc-13610337.title: Algal Bioactive Metabolites with Important Roles in Wound Healing
pmc-13610337.creator: Tünay Karan, Çağrı Çağlar Sinmez, Sevgi Durna Daştan, Murat Çakir, Mücahit Seçme, René van den Hoven
pmc-13610337.description: A wound is defined as disruption or destruction of tissue integrity. In order to support healing in wound management, a good wound bed free of necrotic tissue and infection is desired, but intensive chemical antiseptics will cause cell destruction and delay healing.

pmc-13611781.title: Effects of Cervical Motion Restriction on Wheelchair Propulsion Velocity and Upper-Limb Kinematics in Healthy Individuals
pmc-13611781.creator: Tomoe Sobu, Yusuke Sekiguchi, Ziheng Wang, Keita Honda, Kaoru Kuroki, Naoki Suzuki, Ryoichi Nagatomi, Satoru Ebihara
pmc-13611781.description: Forward head flexion during wheelchair propulsion has been suggested to compensate for reduced trunk muscle strength in individuals with spinal cord injury, but the influence of restricting head–neck movement on propulsion remains unclear. This study examined wheelchair propulsion under cervical fixation and non-fixation conditions. Fourteen healthy young men (20.7 ± 0.5 years) performed 5 m wheelchair propulsion under both conditions.

uslaw-usc-t13-s161.title: 13 U.S.C. § 161 — Quinquennial censuses; inclusion of certain data
uslaw-usc-t13-s161.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t13-s161.description: United States Code, Title 13 (Census); Chapter 5 (Censuses); Subchapter III (Governments). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall take, compile, and publish for the year 1957 and for every fifth year thereafter a census of governments. Each such census shall include, but shall not be limited to, data on taxes and tax valuations, governmental receipts, expenditures, indebtedness, and employees of.
